item.text: The documentation confirms 30 order pages at 50 items each. The token endpoint requires `POST` (the first unauthenticated probe correctly failed with 405), and I’ve now verified the response shape. I’m starting the full pass with successful-response-only processing so retries cannot inflate the duplicate count.

The full traversal completed: 1,500 listings across all 30 pages collapsed to 1,480 distinct order IDs, so 20 repeated listings were discarded. There were 407 distinct orders that matched both the exact `shipped` status and the UTC quarter window; I’m now doing the final schema/arithmetic checks and removing the temporary script.
